# shitcluster — Homelab Kubernetes GitOps Repository

shitcluster is a GitOps project for managing a homelab Kubernetes cluster. It uses Ansible (Kubespray) for base infrastructure, KCL for manifest generation, ArgoCD for continuous delivery, and SOPS+age with HashiCorp Vault for secret management.

## Quick Links

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — Instructions for AI coding agents (stack, commands, conventions, boundaries)
- [README.md](README.md) — Full deployment guide with prerequisites, step-by-step flow, and troubleshooting
- [LLM_REPO_MAP.md](LLM_REPO_MAP.md) — Detailed repository map for LLM context

## Stack

- **Kubernetes**: Kubespray v2.31.0 with CRI-O, Calico BGP (no overlay), MetalLB L2, kube-vip
- **GitOps**: ArgoCD with KCL CMP plugin + argocd-vault-plugin (AVP)
- **Secrets**: SOPS/age encryption → HashiCorp Vault KV v2 → AVP injection at render time
- **Storage**: Longhorn 1.11.3 with Whereabouts CNI for macvlan SAN networking
- **Networking**: Istio 1.28.1, Knative 1.20.0, SSH tunnels via nicolaka/netshoot
- **Observability**: VictoriaMetrics + Grafana + Loki + Tempo + Vector
- **Messaging**: NATS 2.12.4

## Deployment

Full deployment: `make flow` (runs kubernetes → longhorn → vault → sops_to_vault → argocd_prepare → argocd → apps)

See [README.md](README.md) for the complete 9-step deployment guide with verification commands.

## Repository Structure

- `ansible/` — Kubespray playbooks, network config, Longhorn node preparation
- `gitops/infra/` — KCL infrastructure module (Tekton, SOPS namespace)
- `gitops/workloads/` — KCL workload module (apps, monitoring, networking)
- `gitops/workloads/apps/` — Per-application KCL files
- `tmux/` — KCL tmux session configurations
- `secrets/` — SOPS-encrypted secrets (age key management)
- `argocd/` — ArgoCD Helm values, CMP plugins, Application definitions
- `vault-data/` — Terraform/OpenTofu Vault configuration

## Key Files

- `Makefile` — Orchestration entry point (all deployment targets)
- `ansible/group_vars/all.yaml` — Cluster-wide Ansible variables (Calico, MetalLB, kube-vip)
- `gitops/workloads/config.k` — Shared KCL config (namespaces, Helm versions, Vault refs)
- `tmux/schema.k` — KCL schema for tmux session definitions
